title: Book 30 minutes with the person who can actually answer
body: Not a qualification call with an SDR working from a script. You get one of the people who would actually own the build. They will tell you what is achievable and in what order, and if Snowflake is the wrong answer for what you need, you will hear that too.
takeaway: You leave with a sequence you can act on, whether or not you work with us.
agenda: Where the data actually sits today, and which use cases it can carry now
What is achievable in the first 8 to 16 weeks, and in what order
A rough range, and the one thing most likely to blow it up
reassure: No deck. No obligation. No follow-up sequence to unsubscribe from. If it is not a fit, we say so on the call.
